newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon parliament opposes Mideast economic summit.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon parliament opposes Mideast economic summit.

text.p: A Lebanese parliamentary committee on Tuesday called for the cancellation of a controversial Middle East-North Africa economic summit which Israel is expected to attend.

"The (parliamentary foreign affairs) committee urged the cancellation of the meeting and said it should be replaced by an economic summit of Arab states," Ali-al-Khalil, head of the committee, told reporters.

Qatar, host of the conference, the fourth since landmark Middle East peace negotiations began in 1991, is under pressure from some Arab countries that oppose holding it because of the stalled peace process.
Israel attended the previous three summits.
Qatar has said it is committed to holding the meeting.
The president of Israel's Federation of Chambers of Commerce said on Sunday he was assured by the emir of Qatar that Israel would be welcome at the summit.
Qatar's foreign minister recently said Israel's attendance was contingent on progress in the peace process.
Syria and some Gulf Arab states favour postponing the summit until Middle East peace talks resume after being stalled for more than one year, diplomats have said.
Lebanese officials have said Lebanon would not attend the summit.
